description:
REQUIRES: opi-fin.6.1 merged.

FILE: apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/context.ex

Add host: pid() | nil field to Context.t() struct, default nil.
Update Context.new/1 to accept host: key from the attrs map.
Update @type t() spec.

The session runner populates this when creating Context for dispatch: Context.new(%{..., host: host_pid}).

In tests that use Context.new directly (context_test.exs, extension tests), host: nil is fine as long as the extension under test does not call Host client functions. Tests that DO test Host interactions will use Host.Stub (opi-fin.6.4 and opi-fin.6.5).

TEST: Update context_test.exs to cover the new field.
title: 6b: Add host: pid() to Context.t()
